description: Bounded adversarial search over abstract BorderAvoid instances

generator.random: partial binary DFA; p_undefined in {0.02,0.05,0.10,0.16}; p_flag in {0.03,0.06,0.10,0.16,0.24}; sparse final and bad sets

interpretation.exact: EXACT means every lower (L,D) split was exhausted with NO and the reported split returned YES.
interpretation.no_through: NO_THROUGH means all requested budgets were exhausted; it is not a global NO result.
interpretation.scope: All generated instances are abstract BorderAvoid instances. No row establishes a result for SEP or Problem 1.7.
interpretation.unknown: UNKNOWN means a finite state cap interrupted a split and cannot be treated as NO.

replay.description: Independent replay of stored exact and growth examples
